inputs.name: hand over from Data Contracts to Data Ingestion Pipeline

output.level_0: Till data arrives in wrong formats, so the nightly forecast job crashes before it starts.
output.level_1: No pipeline exists, so analysts copy raw scan lines into spreadsheets by hand every night.
output.level_2: A script moves data nightly, but buyers must email fixes when store formats change unexpectedly.
output.level_3: The pipeline ingests all store data automatically, flagging schema mismatches without human intervention.
output.level_4: Ingestion validates data against contracts, blocking bad feeds and alerting data owners immediately.
